blocks.text: Vice President of Engineering — Retained Search

items: Client: Coleman Ltd
Sponsor: Michael Martin, Chief Operating Officer
Engagement opened {{fact:f:E-2016-001.start}}
A retained assignment, run to a written specification rather than a contingency scramble
Prepared by your Northgate search team for this progress review
A Vice President of Engineering to lead the engineering function at {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}}.
A senior operating role, reporting into the leadership team and owning the people in it.
We are looking for an operator who has scaled a function, not a first-time leader.
Someone the current team will follow, not only someone the board will approve.
The written specification agreed at kickoff governs the search from here, and we hold ourselves to it.
John Chang is mapping the engineering-leadership market and building the long list we work from.
James Grant is assessing the strongest sitting leaders against the brief and shaping the shortlist.
Approaches are discreet; we describe candidates by their current seat, never by name, in anything that circulates.
We ask the same discretion of you, since most of the people we approach have not spoken to their employers.
Jeffrey Patterson keeps the search moving day to day and is your single point of contact.
The market map is well advanced and reaching into two adjacent sectors where the experience also sits.
The specification is agreed and already in use to calibrate every name.
The first discreet approaches are underway, and early conversations are encouraging.
Two names stand out so far, both described here by their current seat rather than by name.
No slate yet: we are still widening the field, not narrowing it, which is right for this stage.
Complete the market approaches over the coming weeks and let the field settle.
Work the long list down into a shortlist we will stand behind.
Complete first references before anyone reaches your interview room.
Bring a first slate to Michael Martin for discussion, with candidates ready to meet you.
Hold the weekly rhythm of updates between now and then, so no one has to ask.
